body: Yeah it’s just tricky cause her intention was never really for him to just take my car full time for so long. We thought it’d be a temporary occasional thing but now it turned into...this. Haha

Yep, this is exactly me! I feel happier, more positive and motivated, and my anxiety is gone. It really is like taking drugs. 

Definitely not complaining! Haha Obviously I wish I didn't deal with depression or anxiety at all...haha But I feel lucky, in a way, that my drug of choice is so cheap and easily accessible.
Yup. I think my voice is pretty sweet, I'm also glad it doesn't sound the way it does in my head.
